name: Ibidi mu-Plate 80636 6 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Ibidi mu-Plate 6 Well ibiTreat, catalogue 80636: 6 round flat-bottom wells in a 2 (A-B) x 3 (1-3) grid, black polymer frame (for low well-to-well crosstalk in fluorescence) with an Ibidi Polymer Coverslip bottom, ibiTreat tissue-culture-treated growth surface, sterile, supplied with a lid, single use, not autoclavable (temperature stable to 80 C). DISPLAY NAME: the vendor writes the family name with a Greek mu ('micro-Plate'); every other name in this registry is ASCII, so it is spelled 'mu-Plate' here. SOURCE: every dimension below is read from Ibidi's controlling document, the 'mu-Plate 6 Well Instruction Manual', Version 1.1 (May 18, 2026), published at web_reference, which names 80636 on its first page. Nothing here is derived, measured or substituted from ANSI/SLAS. SIBLING PART: the same manual also covers 80631, the Untreated variant of the same mould - all geometry in this file applies to 80631 unchanged, and only the growth-surface treatment differs. NOT COVERED: 80637 is the glass-bottom mu-Plate 6 Well; it is a different bottom (and a different document) and must not use this file, because the bottom thickness and focal offset below would be wrong for it. Units in meters. Measured values, in millimeters on the manual: footprint length 127.8 +/- 0.2, width 85.5 +/- 0.2; plate height without lid 20.0 +/- 0.4 (22.4 +/- 0.4 with the lid on, which is not modelled here - z_reference is the top surface of the plate itself). Well-to-well distance 37.5 +/- 0.2, the same in both axes, taken from the 'Specifications' table and reproduced by the plan view's dimension chain. Well top diameter 34.0 +/- 0.2, stored in 'diameter' per the top-diameter convention; Ibidi publishes no separate bottom diameter, and 34.0 is also the diameter that reproduces the stated growth area (pi x (34.0/2)^2 = 907.9 mm^2 = 9.08 cm^2 against the stated 9.1 cm^2), so the well is straight-walled at the growth surface. Well depth 18.5 +/- 0.2, measured on section A-A from the well rim down to the growth surface; flat bottom. Recommended volume 5 mL per well. A1 OFFSETS: read directly from the plan view's dimension chain on page 1 - 26.4 from the left edge to the column 1 well centers and 24.0 from the top edge to the row A well centers, with A1 top-left as the plate is numbered. Both close exactly against the footprint: 26.4 + 2 x 37.5 + 26.4 = 127.8 and 24.0 + 37.5 + 24.0 = 85.5, so the grid is exactly centered in both axes and the far margins equal the near ones. Ibidi states the plate meets ANSI/SLAS 1-2004, 2-2004, 3-2004 and 4-2004. WORKING DISTANCE: the bottom is an Ibidi Polymer Coverslip, No. 1.5 (180 um) thick, refractive index 1.52 at 589 nm, Abbe number 56 - not glass, and not detachable from the upper part. Section A-A dimensions the coverslip at 0.18, a 'well clearance' of 0.35 (the air gap between the plate's ground plane and the underside of the coverslip) and a 'focal offset' of 0.53 +/- 0.1 (ground plane to growth surface, i.e. 0.35 + 0.18). The 0.53 focal offset is the number that matters for setting working distance on this plate, and it is far smaller than the 1.2-1.5 mm polystyrene floor of an ordinary culture plate. NOTE ON THE VERTICAL CHAIN: the manual's numbers do not close arithmetically - well depth 18.5 plus focal offset 0.53 is 19.03 against a plate height of 20.0, the difference being the raised rim structure that section A-A draws above the well opening. Each value is recorded as printed rather than back-computed. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
